name: beast-config
description: One agent config installed across Claude Code, Codex, and Grok
//private: Not publishable, and not by accident. beast installs symlinks that point INTO the
clone, so the clone is the source of truth and `git diff` is how you see drift — an
immutable copy under node_modules cannot fill that role. npm also refuses to
materialise the 18 symlinked skill directories in the active set: `npm pack` shipped
9 of 27 active skills, silently, which is worse than not publishing at all.
Install with `git clone` + `npm link`; see README.md.
//engines: 22, not 20. The video pack installs by default and HyperFrames requires Node 22+,
so a machine that satisfied >=20 could still get default functionality that cannot
run. Several vendored media scripts also use import.meta.dirname (Node 20.11+).
